name: Sygnum FIUSD Liquidity Fund
description: This project focuses on the tokenization of Fidelity International's Money Market Fund by Sygnum Bank, specifically the Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund (ILF) USD Fund Class G Acc. Sygnum Bank is the token issuer of the above mentioned.
methodology: TVL represents the total sum of all tokens minted in Fidelity's investment fund (FIUSD)
